notes.title: Release Date and Price Announcement for “Brave × Junction”!
notes.notes: [p]The release date for the Blackjack RPG “Brave × Junction” has been set![/p][p]The PlayStation version will launch on [b]Wednesday, October 8, 2025[/b], while the Steam and Nintendo Switch versions are scheduled for release on [b]Thursday, October 9[/b]![/p][p]The price is [b]10.99＄[/b].[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="spNB_XaT5Zw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Official Homepage　[url="https://www.rideongames.com/bravejunction/"]https://www.rideongames.com/bravejunction/[/url][/p]

notes.title: Demo Version Update Notice
notes.notes: [p]Thank you for trying out the demo version and for completing the questionnaire![/p][p]We've updated the demo version with the following improvements:[/p][p][/p][p]- Redesigned key assignment for changing expressions in the status menu[/p][p]- Added cursor movement settings for AZERTY keyboards[/p][p]- Adjusted the volume levels of certain sound effects and voice lines[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll continue enhancing the experience for future releases—stay tuned for more updates![/p]
